summary:
The Communities of Recovery Reauthorization Act of 2025 amends the Public Health Service Act to reauthorize appropriations for the “building communities of recovery” grant program.

Section 1 designates the short title as the “Communities of Recovery Reauthorization Act of 2025.”

Section 2 amends section 547(f) of the Public Health Service Act, codified at 42 U.S.C. 290ee-2(f), by replacing the existing authorization of appropriations of $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 through 2023 with an authorization of $17,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030. The bill does not otherwise amend the eligibility criteria, permissible uses, administration, or substantive requirements of the underlying grant authority. The amendment is an authorization of appropriations only and does not itself appropriate funds.
